derivation: Spot-check per plan (long period 14, not fully hand-digit-verified): this is a strictly monotonic uptrend (every bar's low and high both rise), so -DM is always 0 and +DM is always positive -> +DI dominates -DI completely -> DX saturates at 100 for every bar once the Wilder warmup completes, and ADX (itself a Wilder average of DX) also saturates at 100. Warmup: +DM/-DM/ATR need a first run of 14 consecutive non-NaN values starting at index1 (index0's diff is NaN) -> first DX at index14. ADX is a second Wilder smoothing of DX needing another 14-value run of non-NaN DX starting at index14 -> first non-NaN ADX at index 14+14-1=27, matching the computed NaN-through-index=26 boundary. Values past warmup are read directly from the implementation (bot.indicators.adx.adx) and asserted for regression, consistent with the plan's spot-check + NaN-warmup rule for periods >= 14.
